scope: Full-HP potion guard and live current-battle hit reserve only; no entry vetoes, prices, roles, defaults, manifest, archive or docs changes.
behavior: rbTurnHeal keeps the existing numerical floor/at and all real-deficit urgency, but need=false at cur>=max.
Normal and emergency potion calls recheck fresh HP through existing act stillNeeded after gameFree/global wait; canceled requests roll back lastHpPot and potion timing bookkeeping.
Current-battle finite positive boss hits cannot be hidden by an older lower d.hitP90. Prior fallback is retained. Stored d.maxHit and other boss records are not treated as fresh hits.
testingBoundary: Behavioral VM executes actual source rbTurnHeal, actual normal/emergency potion blocks and actual act until the fire boundary. Controlled clock/HP/game waits; no browser or live game run.
causalityBoundary: Wasted full-HP potion turns contribute inefficiency; these changes do not establish that potions could outheal the bosses or prevent every death.
